banner.title: <Demo name>
banner.text: Beats from cold start to composition. Default posture: mock models, local, no keys. You only Ctrl-C an agent worker for the durability beats.

demo.talk_track: There are two layers of durability here. The outer harness is the business process. The inner harnesses are the agents themselves. In mock mode we stub only the model, never the integration, so everything you see is real except the words the model would have said.
lanes: Server-side truth. Survives a worker dying. Point here to prove durability.
Live worker state. Goes OFFLINE when that worker is down, which dims the pipeline.
The ordered steps of the run.
Each agent's model and tool calls as they land as Activities.
demo.smoke: Smoke check: click Start happy. Within a second or two the steps go green. If that works, you are fully up.

beats.title: Happy path
rows: One durable run completes with every call recorded.
No queue, no glue; every call is a recorded Activity.

beats.title: Money moment
beats.term: ⌨ Ctrl-C the worker, leave it stopped. Restart later with cmd worker-a.
rows: Kill a worker mid-flight; the run survives and resumes.
WORKER flips OFFLINE and the pipeline dims; PLATFORM stays RUNNING.
After restart it resumes exactly where it was.
We killed the worker and lost nothing. Earlier steps are not re-run.
beats.note: Timing: take the worker down first, then start the run, so you are never racing the clock.

demo.switch_note: Unset means local dev server and mock models. Restart the affected worker after changing env.
troubleshooting: run the preflight; it re-adds the integration extras and verifies imports.
Ctrl-C all terminals; local dev server state is in-memory.
